title: PMPM
one_line_definition: Calculates the average visit amount per member per month by dividing total year-to-date visit amount by total year-to-date member count.
numerator_meaning: Total year-to-date visit amount across all attributed members, with no flag filter applied.
denominator_meaning: Total year-to-date member count across all attributed members, with no flag filter applied.
result_meaning: The average dollar amount of visit costs incurred per attributed member per month in the current year-to-date period.

measure_meanings.PMPM: Calculates the average year-to-date visit amount per attributed member by dividing total visit amount by total member count.
measure_meanings.PMPM YoY Card: Displays the year-over-year percentage change in PMPM compared to the same period last year, formatted as an upward or downward arrow with percentage.
